cat > /tmp/test_engine.py << 'EOF'
from template_engine import TemplateEngine

def check(desc, got, expected):
    status = "OK " if got == expected else "FAIL"
    print(f"[{status}] {desc}: got={got!r} expected={expected!r}")

# 1. Simple variable
check("var", TemplateEngine("Hello {{ name }}!").render({'name': 'World'}), "Hello World!")

# 2. Dotted path
check("dotted", TemplateEngine("{{ user.name }} is {{ user.age }}").render({'user': {'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}}), "Alice is 30")

# 3. if/else
check("if-true", TemplateEngine("{% if logged_in %}Welcome{% else %}Please log in{% endif %}").render({'logged_in': True}), "Welcome")
check("if-false", TemplateEngine("{% if logged_in %}Welcome{% else %}Please log in{% endif %}").render({'logged_in': False}), "Please log in")

# 4. if without else
check("ifnoelse-true", TemplateEngine("{% if show %}Visible{% endif %}!").render({'show': True}), "Visible!")
check("ifnoelse-false", TemplateEngine("{% if show %}Visible{% endif %}!").render({'show': False}), "!")

# 5. for loop
check("for", TemplateEngine("{% for item in items %}{{ item }},{% endfor %}").render({'items': [1, 2, 3]}), "1,2,3,")

# 6. comments
check("comment", TemplateEngine("A{# hidden {{ x }} #}B").render({'x': 1}), "AB")

# 7. loop over dicts
check("for-dicts", TemplateEngine("{% for u in users %}{{ u.name }} {% endfor %}").render({'users': [{'name': 'a'}, {'name': 'b'}]}), "a b ")

# 8. == condition
check("eq", TemplateEngine("{% if count == 3 %}three{% else %}other{% endif %}").render({'count': 3}), "three")
check("neq", TemplateEngine("{% if count != 3 %}notthree{% endif %}").render({'count': 4}), "notthree")

# 9. not condition
check("not", TemplateEngine("{% if not banned %}ok{% endif %}").render({'banned': False}), "ok")

# 10. string comparison
check("streq", TemplateEngine("{% if role == \"admin\" %}Admin{% else %}User{% endif %}").render({'role': 'admin'}), "Admin")

# 11. if inside for
check("if-in-for", TemplateEngine("{% for n in nums %}{% if n == 2 %}TWO{% else %}{{ n }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}").render({'nums': [1, 2, 3]}), "1TWO3")

# 12. no trailing junk
check("no-junk", TemplateEngine("plain").render({}), "plain")

# 13. dotted list expr in for
check("for-dotted", TemplateEngine("{% for x in data.items %}{{ x }}{% endfor %}").render({'data': {'items': ['a', 'b']}}), "ab")
EOF

python3 - << 'PYEOF'
src = open('/app/template_engine.py').read()
old = """        # Process if/else/endif blocks
        result = self._process_if_blocks(result, context)

        # Process for loops
        result = self._process_for_loops(result, context)
"""
new = """        # Process for loops
        result = self._process_for_loops(result, context)

        # Process if/else/endif blocks
        result = self._process_if_blocks(result, context)
"""
if old in src:
    open('/app/template_engine.py', 'w').write(src.replace(old, new))
    print("patched")
else:
    print("already patched or pattern not found")
PYEOF
